title: Syll：开源个人自动化框架，支持跨界面执行
summary: Syll 是一个开源、自托管的个人AI代理框架，统一了MCP/API工具、CLI执行和视觉GUI控制。其核心是双向用户-代理交互层：用户通过演示教学，Syll将其编译为可复用技能；代理执行转化为多模态证据供审查。支持Photoshop等桌面应用，可作为可教学、可审计、可扩展的个人自动化基础。
summary_en: Syll is an open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework unifying MCP/API tools, CLI, and visual GUI control. Its core is a bidirectional user-agent interaction layer: users teach via demonstration, compiled into reusable skills; agent execution is translated into multimodal evidence for inspection. Validated on desktop apps like Photoshop, it serves as a teachable, auditable, extensible foundation for personal automation.
